## Goal
- Build a Go web SPA mimicking a minimal ChatGPT-like interface using Go 1.26, templ, htmx, and Tailwind CSS.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Use newest Go in mise (1.26.4); use `edit`/`write` only, no `apply_patch`.
- Standard library `net/http`, `templ`, HTMX, Tailwind CSS v4.
- Strict componentization: handlers, service layer, templates/components package.
- LLM routing via env vars: `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` (default OpenRouter), fallback to `OLLAMA_BASE_URL`/`OLLAMA_MODEL` (default `http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1`, `qwen2.5:0.5b`).
- No secrets in repo; graceful fallback when keys are missing.
- Table-driven Go tests with mocks/`httptest`; `go test -cover` must pass.
- Lint with `gofmt`, `go vet`, `golangci-lint`, `gosec`.
- Deliver `README.md`, multi-stage `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`.
- Phase 1 of 2: focus on implementation, tests, and structure.

## Progress
### Done
- Verified runtime tools (Go 1.26.4, templ v0.3.1020, Tailwind CLI, golangci-lint, gosec).
- Initialized Go module (`chatapp`) and created directory structure (`internal/handler`, `internal/service`, `internal/llm`, `css`, `templates/components`, `templates/pages`, `tests`).
- Implemented `internal/llm/llm.go` (interfaces, types) and `internal/llm/client.go` (OpenRouter & Ollama fallback, SSE streaming).
- Implemented `internal/service/service.go` (chat service layer).
- Implemented `internal/handler/handler.go` (HTTP handlers) and `internal/handler/helper.go` (ID generation, SSE escaping).
- Created `templates/components/layout.templ`, `templates/components/chat.templ`, `templates/pages/index.templ`.
- Created `main.go` wiring service, LLM client, and HTTP mux with static file serving.
- Configured Tailwind CSS v4 build pipeline: `npm install @tailwindcss/cli@4 tailwindcss@4 @tailwindcss/postcss@4 postcss@8`, `css/app.css`, `tailwind.config.js`, `postcss.config.js`.

### In Progress
- [none] (Implementation paused awaiting `templ generate` fix and Tailwind build).

### Blocked
- Secrets file `~/.config/zsh/secrets` not found; code handles gracefully by defaulting to local Ollama.
- `templ generate` failed due to syntax errors in `.templ` templates.

## Key Decisions
- Single `OpenAIClient` struct implements `LLMClient`, switching behavior dynamically based on environment variables.
- SSE streaming used for real-time responses via custom server-side event emitter.
- Templ enforces strict component separation; avoided single-file `main.go` monolith.
- Project structure adheres to Go internal package convention for encapsulation.
- Tailwind CSS v4 adopted with PostCSS v8 plugin for modern build setup.

5. Create `README.md`, `Dockerfile`, `docker-compose.yml`.
6. Run linters (`golangci-lint`, `gosec`, `go vet`) and fix issues.
